name: Magic Solar
old_description: Transform your business, farm or home with the limitless power of solar energy. Magic Solar is Idaho's trusted partner for reliable solar installations built to fit every project. Whether you're a business aiming for environmental responsibility or a homeowner seeking energy independence, our solar energy systems are designed and built to support your needs. We know every solar panel we install contributes to a brighter, greener tomorrow for Boise, Twin Falls, and beyond.
about:
Magic Solar operates from Boise, Idaho, serving the Treasure Valley, Magic Valley, and surrounding communities including Twin Falls. The company provides solar energy installations for commercial, agricultural, and residential properties. While the firm emphasizes over 40 years of combined team experience, a specific founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The installer designs and deploys photovoltaic systems through a six-step process: free on-site estimation, design approval, permitting management, installation, inspections, and system setup with owner training. Services span commercial solar installations that reduce overhead and add backup power, residential systems for energy independence, and ongoing maintenance to protect system performance. The company also guides customers through federal and state incentives such as the Investment Tax Credit, USDA REAP grants, and Idaho-specific tax deductions.

Magic Solar serves businesses seeking environmental responsibility and cost savings, farms and rural enterprises leveraging USDA programs, and homeowners across the Treasure and Magic Valleys. The team coordinates with local utilities and building departments to handle permitting and interconnection paperwork.

The company differentiates itself through its "Our Knowledge Is Your Power" philosophy, backed by six core values — Attitude, Integrity, Character, Vision, Determination, and Safety. Technicians receive weekly safety briefings and advanced construction supervisory training through AGC programs, while foremen hold certificates from AGC's Supervisory Training Program. Community involvement includes partnerships with the Boys and Girls Club, Twin Falls School District Education Foundation, and The Jae Foundation. A related entity, Magic Valley Electric LLC, supports the electrical contracting side of projects.
